$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: Switch state (checked/unchecked) is conveyed by toggle position and color together, not color alone.
Switch boundaries and focus rings are clearly distinguishable from background in both light and dark modes with adequate contrast.
All visible labels ('Dark mode', 'Auto-save enabled', 'Email digest') match their screen reader announcements.
No text is cut off or truncated across any story.
All focused screenshots show a prominent blue outline/ring around the switch, making focus obvious at a glance.
